ruling: N4 (Monte-Carlo tolerance rule), signed 2026-10-05, vault D-319: 'yes, with the rule stated before any run'
estimand: the 95% percentile parametric-bootstrap interval for two-level repeatability (ICC) of each of the 4 traits of the twolevel_small fixture, as each engine's public bootstrap route computes it with nsim = 200

calls.r: set.seed(s); confint(fit_tl, parm = 'icc', method = 'bootstrap', level = 0.95, nsim = 200)
calls.julia: GLLVModels.repeatability_ci(fit_tl, Y_tl, individual; method = :bootstrap, nsim = 200, seed = s)

fixture: twolevel_small, built exactly as tools/core070_surface_conversion_batch.R builds it (set.seed(1), p = 4, 30 individuals x 4 replicates); Julia fits the same Y natively (fit_twolevel_gaussian(Y_tl, individual; K_B = 1, K_W = 1))
quantities: 8 per engine and seed: lower and upper endpoint for each of the 4 traits
per_seed_structural_check: for every seed and engine: all endpoints finite, lower <= upper, and lower <= point <= upper with that engine's own point estimate (the existing CI-ROUTE-011 structural check)

test.statistic: for each of the 8 quantities q: d_q = mean_R(q) - mean_J(q) over the 5 seeds; se_q = sqrt(var_R(q)/5 + var_J(q)/5) with sample variances (denominator 4)
test.why_4_5: two-sided Welch t critical value for an overall family-wise level of about 0.01 over 8 comparisons (0.00125 each) at about 8 degrees of freedom is about 4.5; 0.005 on the [0,1] ICC scale is a floor so that two near-deterministic sides do not fail on rounding
test.fail_rule: any quantity outside the bound, any structural check failing, or any engine error on any seed is a FAIL; the row then stays unbound and the result is reported as measured
test.no_retuning: the constants 4.5 and 0.005, the seeds and nsim are fixed here before any run and are not changed after seeing a result; a re-run with other constants needs a new rule file and a new signature

compute: single-threaded (OPENBLAS/OMP threads 1, JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1); one R seed is timed first and the total estimated; if the estimate exceeds 1.5 hours the run stops and is reported instead
